content.text: The profile shows one change: a new column `member_note` (position 4, free text, PHI-labelled, no empty values). Everything else matches the contract. I'll add that column as an optional PHI string and validate.

input.contract_yaml:
# Member eligibility from a (synthetic) payer: one row per member, one file per day.
# Generated from the Synthea patients by packs/healthcare/generators/eligibility.py.
feed: healthcare.eligibility
version: 2
owner: vendor-ops@example.com
description: >
  Daily full eligibility file: every enrolled member with their plan and coverage dates.
  All data is synthetic.
classification: restricted
source:
  channels: [minio, sftp, api]
  filename_pattern: "elig_*.csv"
  # The business date in the name (elig_YYYYMMDD.csv). It must be a real date, not after
  # the day the file was received, and at most 7 days before it; otherwise the file is
  # quarantined (FILE.NAME_DATE). A name with no digits takes the date it was received.
  filename_date:
    regex: "^elig_([0-9]+)"
    format: "%Y%m%d"
    max_days_before_received: 7
    max_days_after_received: 0
format: { type: csv, delimiter: ",", encoding: utf-8, header: true }
expected_arrival: { cron: "0 6 * * *", grace: 2h }
on_row_violation: quarantine_row
max_bad_row_ratio: 0.05          # above this, the whole file is rejected
min_rows: 1
columns:
  - { name: member_id, type: string, required: true, unique: true, pattern: "^M[0-9]{9}$" }
  - { name: first_name, type: string, required: true, phi: true }
  - { name: last_name, type: string, required: true, phi: true }
  - { name: dob, type: date, required: true, min: "1900-01-01", max: today, phi: true }
  - { name: sex, type: string, required: true, allowed: [F, M, U] }
  - { name: plan_code, type: string, required: true, allowed: [HMO, PPO, EPO, HDHP] }
  - { name: coverage_start, type: date, required: true, min: "1990-01-01" }
  - { name: coverage_end, type: date, description: "Empty while coverage is open" }
  - name: patient_ref
    type: string
    description: The payer's link to the clinical record (here the Synthea patient id)
    phi: true
  - name: member_note
    type: string
    description: Free-text note on the member (added in file version 2; may hold personal details)
    phi: true

input.rationale: Drift in elig_20261021.csv (job 1): the file has a new column `member_note` (position 4), not in the contract. It is free text with no empty values and consistent shapes, so it looks like a deliberate addition rather than a vendor mistake. The profile labels it phi: true (free_text), so the contract declares it phi: true, as the PHI rule requires for free-text notes. It is optional (no required, no pattern, no allowed list), since the contract's required rules apply only to identifiers, dates and amounts. Nothing else changed: existing columns keep their rules and phi flags, and version goes 1 -> 2. Loosening: none (validator reported an empty loosening list). Dry run: 24 accepted, 0 rejected, file not rejected.

content.text:
- **File change:** `elig_20261021.csv` has a new column, `member_note` (position 4). It is free text, filled in every row, and labelled PHI. It looks like a deliberate vendor addition, not a broken file.
- **Contract change:** I added `member_note` as an optional `phi: true` string column and bumped the version from 1 to 2. Existing columns are unchanged.
- **Loosening:** None. The validator reported an empty loosening list.
- **Dry run:** 24 accepted, 0 rejected, file not rejected. I submitted candidate `04fab41da10d2f06` for a person to review.
